body: Audit B-53, proven on a real stack (6 Nov 2026): setup was given the owner's name 'Audit Owner' but the login answer says person.name 'owner1' and the invitation page says 'owner1 invited you'. setup.py:129 gives the name to the music server only; library.ensure_person (library.py:37-40) stores the login as the display name. A friend's first screen names the owner by a login. Fix in setup + ensure_person, and the installer asks 'What should your friends call you?'. docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md B-53.
